name: SLV temporary residence (general) — art. 108
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería, Decreto Legislativo N.º 286 of 2 April 2019 (Diario Oficial N.º 75, Tomo N.º 423, 25 April 2019), art. 108, as amended. Consolidated text served by the Asamblea Legislativa.
quote_original: Art. 108.- La Dirección General otorgará una autorización de ingreso y permanencia por un tiempo definido, que será hasta por un período de dos años, prorrogables en igual período
notes: Art. 108 is the general temporary-residence grant: DGME authorises entry and stay for a defined time, up to two years, renewable for an equal period. Art. 109 then enumerates 23 qualities that may hold it. Art. 110 sets the general requirements (valid passport; police/criminal record certificate from the country of origin or residence for the two years before entry, apostilled or authenticated; proof of economic solvency where no work authorisation is sought, or of the sponsor's; employer letter of commitment where work is sought), art. 111 the lighter Central American list. Art. 113 caps cumulative temporary permanence at five years save in specially qualified cases. Work is a SEPARATE authorisation under art. 122 (own-account activities only as DGME authorises; employed work needs a favourable MTPS opinion, deemed favourable after 30 working days), so work_rights is recorded null rather than forced into an enum value the instrument does not support. Also folded into this row's note rather than authored as its own route: art. 109(9) with arts. 120–121 (spouse or non-marital partner of a Salvadoran, up to two years renewable, DGME verifying family roots to prevent fraud) — the residence taxonomy has no family category, so a separate row would have to be miscategorised.

name: SLV art. 119 minimum presence — 90 days (DL 531/2026)
instrument: Decreto Legislativo N.º 531, Reformas a la Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería, 17 March 2026, published in Diario Oficial N.º 57, Tomo N.º 450, of 23 March 2026, in force eight days after publication (31 March 2026). Art. 2 substitutes art. 119 of the Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería.
quote_original: Art.119.- Toda persona con residencia temporal deberá permanecer en el territorio salvadoreño un mínimo de noventa días calendario dentro de cada año, ya sean estos consecutivos o acumulados, salvo que exista caso fortuito o fuerza mayor debidamente justificado ante la Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería.
notes: This is the rule that gets attached to every El Salvador temporary residence row as physical_presence_days_per_year = 90. It is general to the status, not to any one programme: 'toda persona con residencia temporal'. Consecutive or accumulated days both count, and fortuitous event or force majeure duly justified before DGME excuses it. Confirmed landed in the consolidated law: art. 119 there now carries the reform marker (3) and the footnote table identifies (3) as D. L. N° 531, 17 DE MARZO DE 2026, D. O. N° 57, T. 450, 23 DE MARZO DE 2026. Deliberately NOT recorded on the residencia definitiva rows: art. 119 binds temporary residents only, and definitive residents are governed by art. 154 (absence of up to two years, extendable by permission), so those rows keep physical_presence_days_per_year null. Monitor lead #221. Fetch mechanics: asamblea.gob.sv hangs Bun's fetch and serves this PDF with eight junk bytes before the %PDF- header; scripts/lib/quote-gate.ts already handles both (curl fallback on any transport failure, header scanned rather than demanded at offset 0).

name: SLV art. 49(5) loss of temporary residence — 90 days (DL 531/2026)
instrument: Decreto Legislativo N.º 531, art. 1, substituting numeral 5) of art. 49 of the Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería.
quote_original: 5) Teniendo residencia temporal, no permanezcan en el territorio nacional por un período mínimo de noventa días calendario dentro de cada año, ya sean estos consecutivos o acumulados.
notes: The enforcement limb: failing the ninety days is a ground of LOSS of temporary residence under art. 49(5). Recorded so the presence figure is not read as advisory.

name: SLV DL 531 commencement
instrument: Decreto Legislativo N.º 531, art. 5 (commencement).
quote_original: Art.5.- El presente decreto entrará en vigencia ocho días después de su publicación en el Diario Oficial.
notes: Published 23 March 2026, so in force 31 March 2026. The monitor lead's '11 March' approval date is wrong (the decree is dated 17 March 2026).

name: SLV art. 113 five-year cap on temporary permanence
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 113 (final paragraph).
quote_original: La permanencia temporal de cualquier persona extranjera no podrá exceder de cinco años, excepto en casos especialmente calificados por la Dirección General.
notes: Temporary permanence cannot exceed five years except in cases specially qualified by DGME. Sets the outer bound on renewals for every temporary row, and is why the ladder to residencia definitiva (three years under art. 152(4)) matters rather than indefinite renewal.

name: SLV temporary residence — investor (art. 109(1))
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 109 numeral 1, with art. 90 (definition of an investor for migration purposes) and art. 92–93 (the investor visa/frequent-traveller card confers no residence).
quote_original: 1) Inversionistas extranjeros, que necesiten más del tiempo otorgado en el permiso especial, o soliciten directamente dicha calidad. En este caso, podrá concederse residencia con ingreso y salida múltiple por un plazo hasta de dos años prorrogables.
notes: min_investment is NULL and that is deliberate: art. 109(1) states no capital floor. Art. 90 defines an investor for migration purposes as a president, board member, legal representative or shareholder of a Salvadoran commercial company, or the owner/general manager of a company holding an active investment in the country 'atendiendo a lo establecido en la Ley de Inversiones' — the threshold, if any, lives in the Ley de Inversiones and was not read here. Art. 92 is important context and is the reason this row exists separately from the visa: the investor visa, frequent-traveller card and special permit expressly do NOT confer temporary or definitive residence. Art. 93 sets the frequent-traveller card at up to three years and the multiple-entry investor visa at up to two years renewable. DGME confirms the product administratively as form F4.

name: SLV DGME temporary residence product list
instrument: Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería, Servicios — Residencias temporales (application forms F1–F31).
quote_original: F4 Residencia Temporal Inversionista F5 Residencia Temporal Negocios F6 Residencia Temporal Representante Comercial F7 Residencia Temporal Pensionados F8 Residencia Temporal Rentista
notes: Administrative confirmation that the statutory categories are live products, each with its own form and its own prórroga form: F4 investor, F7 pensionado, F8 rentista, F11 accionista (art. 109(13) shareholder), F12 comerciantes individuales (art. 109(14) sole trader), F2/F3 ordinary temporary residence without and with work authorisation, F10 studies. Page carries 'Publicado el 10-11-2020' and no revision date, so it is cited as corroboration of the product set, never as the source of a threshold.

name: SLV temporary residence — company shareholder USD 10,000 (art. 109(13))
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 109 numeral 13.
quote_original: 13) Las personas extranjeras no centroamericanas de origen que constituyan sociedades salvadoreñas y que hayan suscrito y pagado como accionista en dicha sociedad no menos de diez mil Dólares de los Estados Unidos de América, podrá concederse residencia con ingreso y salida múltiple por un plazo de hasta dos años prorrogables.
notes: USD 10,000 subscribed AND paid as a shareholder in a Salvadoran company the applicant has formed. Nationality gate cuts the other way from most preferences: the numeral is written for persons NOT of Central American origin, because Central Americans by birth already reach residencia definitiva directly under art. 152(1)–(2) and do not need this limb. DGME form F11 (Residencia Temporal Accionista).

name: SLV temporary residence — sole trader USD 2,500 (art. 109(14))
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 109 numeral 14.
quote_original: 14) Las personas extranjeras no centroamericanas de origen que sean comerciantes individuales titulares de empresas mercantiles cuyos activos no sean inferiores a dos mil quinientos Dólares de los Estados Unidos de América, podrá concederse residencia con ingreso y salida múltiple por un plazo de hasta dos años prorrogables.
notes: Individual merchants (comerciantes individuales) owning mercantile businesses whose ASSETS are not less than USD 2,500 — an asset test, not a capital transfer, and the lowest investment-linked residence floor in the atlas. Same non-Central-American framing as art. 109(13). DGME form F12.

name: SLV residente pensionado (arts. 109(6), 144)
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería arts. 109 numeral 6 and 144 (Sub Sección F, Régimen de personas residentes pensionados y rentistas).
quote_original: Art. 144.- Se entenderá como residente pensionado a toda persona extranjera que ingrese al territorio nacional y reciba pensiones mensuales, permanentes y estables provenientes del exterior, cuyo monto no sea inferior a tres salarios mínimos mensuales vigentes correspondientes al sector comercio y servicios, destinados para su subsistencia en el país, cumpliendo los requisitos establecidos en la presente Ley. El residente pensionado no podrá dedicarse a ninguna clase de trabajo remunerado, salvo el trabajo con el Estado, Municipios o Instituciones Oficiales Autónomas, en materia especializada o la docencia.
notes: Income floor is THREE minimum monthly wages for the commerce and services sector, from monthly, permanent and stable pensions sourced abroad. The statute states a multiplier, not a sum, so the recorded figure is derived: 3 x USD 408.80 = USD 1,226.40 per month on the tariff in force from 1 June 2025 (see the MTPS row). It moves whenever the Consejo Nacional del Salario Mínimo raises the tariff, and costs.means carries pegged_to so the peg travels with the number. Work: art. 144 bars any kind of remunerated work SAVE work for the State, municipalities or autonomous official institutions in a specialised field, or teaching. Recorded as work_rights 'none' with the carve-out in the note, on the Kenya Class K pattern; art. 150 sanctions breach with cancellation of the status. Term one year under art. 109(6), renewable (DGME prórroga form F22). Art. 146 attaches tax and customs benefits (income-tax exemption on declared foreign-sourced sums; duty-free household goods up to USD 20,000 CIF once; one vehicle up to USD 25,000 CIF once every five years, transferable only after five years with Ministry of Finance authorisation), extended to the accompanying spouse or partner and minor children. Art. 147 claws the exempted taxes back if the holder switches category within four years. Art. 148 loses the status on absence exceeding six consecutive months, or six months in intervals within the same calendar year, save justified cause — a stricter absence rule than the general art. 119 presence floor, and both are recorded.

name: SLV residente rentista (arts. 109(5), 145)
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería arts. 109 numeral 5 and 145.
quote_original: Art. 145.- Se entenderá como residente rentista a toda persona extranjera que ingrese al territorio nacional y recibe rentas mensuales, permanentes y estables, provenientes del exterior o generadas del exterior, cuyo monto no sea inferior a cuatro salarios mínimos mensuales vigentes correspondientes al sector comercio y servicios, destinados para su subsistencia en el país. El residente rentista no podrá dedicarse a ninguna clase de trabajo remunerado, salvo el trabajo con el Estado, Municipios o Instituciones Oficiales Autónomas, en materia especializada o docencia. El ingreso a que se refiere el inciso anterior no podrá ser inferior a seis salarios mínimos vigentes correspondiente al sector comercio y servicios, cuando las personas que acompañen al residente fueren dos o más.
notes: Income floor is FOUR minimum monthly wages for the commerce and services sector, rising to SIX where two or more people accompany the resident. Derived figures on the tariff in force from 1 June 2025: 4 x USD 408.80 = USD 1,635.20 per month for the principal, 6 x USD 408.80 = USD 2,452.80 with two or more accompanying persons. min_income_monthly records the principal floor; the family uplift is in the note and in costs.means.detail rather than as a second route. Same work bar and carve-out as the pensionado (art. 145 second paragraph), same art. 146–148 benefits, clawback and absence rule. Term one year under art. 109(5), renewable (DGME form F8, prórroga F23).

name: SLV pensionado/rentista absence rule (art. 148)
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 148.
quote_original: Art. 148.- El pensionado o rentista podrá salir y entrar libremente del territorio nacional, pero perderá su calidad migratoria si su ausencia excediere de seis meses consecutivos o por ese período en intervalos dentro de un mismo año calendario, salvo causas justificadas.
notes: Pensionado and rentista lose the status if absence exceeds six consecutive months, or six months in intervals within the same calendar year, save justified cause. Sits alongside art. 119's ninety-day minimum presence: the two are not the same test, and neither is inferred from the other.

name: SLV pensionado/rentista route to residencia definitiva (art. 152(10))
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 152 numeral 10.
quote_original: 10) El residente pensionado o rentista que haya obtenido tal calidad durante un año anterior a la solicitud.
notes: One year in the pensionado or rentista quality reaches residencia definitiva — twelve months, not the general thirty-six of art. 152(4). This is why both rows carry counts_toward_permanent_residence true with eligibility_minimum_months 12, and why no separate PR row was authored for them: the milestone already expresses it. DGME serves form F33 (Residencia Definitiva para Pensionado) for it. Art. 147 also states expressly that 'El pensionado o rentista podrá obtener la residencia definitiva, cumpliendo los requisitos establecidos en esta Ley.'

name: SLV minimum wage, commerce and services (peg for arts. 144–145)
instrument: Ministerio de Trabajo y Previsión Social — announcement of the Consejo Nacional del Salario Mínimo's unanimous approval of a 12% minimum-wage increase, effective 1 June 2025.
quote_original: sectores industria comercio y servicio tendrán un nuevo salario de $408.80 mensuales, siendo el actual de $365
notes: The base for the arts. 144–145 multipliers: USD 408.80 per month for industry, commerce and services from 1 June 2025 (up from USD 365.00, the tariff set in July 2021). This is a ministry page, not the instrument. NOT VERIFIED: the CNSM decree itself. The Diario Oficial issues of 29 and 30 May and 2 June 2025 were downloaded from diariooficial.gob.sv (POST to /api/v1/diarios-disponibles with year and month maps a date to an Id, then GET /seleccion/{Id} returns the issue PDF) and extracted with pdftotext; all three yield text but the consultation-copy watermark is interleaved into it and none contains the wage tables, so the decree number and its exact effective date remain unread. The derived income floors are therefore recorded with pegged_to naming the multiplier and the sector, so a stale tariff is visible rather than silent.

name: SLV residencia definitiva — definition and work rights (arts. 151, 152)
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería arts. 151 and 152 (penultimate paragraph).
quote_original: Art. 151.- Para efectos migratorios se consideran residentes definitivos las personas extranjeras que, habiendo cumplido con todos los requisitos que establece la Ley, adquieran el derecho de permanecer en el país por tiempo indefinido y realizar cualquier actividad lícita en igualdad de condiciones que los salvadoreños
notes: Residencia definitiva is the right to remain indefinitely and carry on any lawful activity on equal terms with Salvadorans, subject to constitutional limits. Art. 152's penultimate paragraph states the labour-market access directly, which is why this is the one El Salvador row with work_rights 'full'. Art. 153: the definitive residence card is endorsed (refrenda) for one to four years on payment; failure to apply within thirty calendar days before expiry draws a fine, and failure within the year after expiry loses the right to reside.

name: SLV residencia definitiva — work rights (art. 152)
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 152, penultimate paragraph.
quote_original: Todo residente definitivo podrá ejercer actividades remuneradas o lucrativas lícitas, por cuenta propia o en relación de dependencia.
notes: Full labour-market access, own-account or employed. Read from the instrument, so work_rights 'full' rather than null.

name: SLV residencia definitiva — three years as temporary resident (art. 152(4))
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 152 numeral 4.
quote_original: 4) Residentes temporales que hayan tenido tal condición durante los tres años anteriores a la solicitud.
notes: The ordinary ladder: three years of temporary residence immediately before the application. eligibility_minimum_months 36. DGME form F32 (Residencia Definitiva para Categorías Varias). Art. 152(5) offers a fallback for people who lapsed — those who failed to renew within no more than twelve months and have over seven years of regular permanence — which is recorded in the note rather than as its own row because it is a cure for a broken clock, not a route someone plans.

name: SLV residencia definitiva — absences (art. 154)
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 154.
quote_original: Art. 154.- El residente definitivo tendrá libertad de salir y entrar al país y ausentarse hasta por dos años, pero si desea permanecer en el extranjero por más tiempo, deberá solicitar permiso a la Dirección General, la cual lo concederá por un plazo no mayor a un año adicional, previo pago del permiso y de los derechos de refrenda.
notes: Definitive residents may be absent up to two years, extendable by DGME permission for at most one further year, with a further extension available on justified cause. This is why physical_presence_days_per_year stays NULL on the definitiva rows: art. 119's ninety-day floor is written for temporary residents and art. 154 is the rule that actually governs presence here. It is also the article that art. 152(13) expressly exempts its beneficiaries from.

name: SLV DGME definitive residence product list
instrument: Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería, Servicios — Residencias definitivas (forms F32–F43).
quote_original: F32 Residencia Definitiva para Categorías Varias F33 Residencia Definitiva para Pensionado F34 Residencia Definitiva para Casado o Conviviente de Salvadoreño
notes: Administrative confirmation of the definitiva product set. 'Categorías Varias' (F32) is the form covering the art. 152 numerals that have no dedicated form, including the three-year ordinary ladder and the Spanish/Hispano-American one-year limb.

name: SLV residencia definitiva — Central Americans by birth (art. 152(1)–(2))
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 152 numerals 1 and 2.
quote_original: 1) Los centroamericanos por nacimiento que ingresen al país de forma regular, sin que previamente haya adquirido la residencia temporal. 2) Los residentes temporales de origen centroamericano por nacimiento.
notes: Central Americans by birth entering regularly reach residencia definitiva with NO prior temporary residence, so eligibility_minimum_months 0. Numeral 2 covers those who are already temporary residents. Read narrowly: 'centroamericanos por nacimiento' is birth in a Central American state, which the atlas treats as an origin-of-birth limb, not an ancestry test. Fee is the lower Central American tariff, USD 135.00 for a first grant of up to one year against USD 345.00 for non-Central Americans (art. 325). Onward: art. 155 lets natives of the other states of the former Federal Republic of Central America acquire Salvadoran nationality BY BIRTH after one year of definitive residence with domicile, matching Constitution art. 90(3) and the existing el-salvador-central-american-option citizenship route.

name: SLV Central American nationality by birth after one year of PR (art. 155)
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 155.
quote_original: Art. 155.- Las personas extranjeras originarias de los demás Estados que constituyeron la República Federal de Centro América podrán adquirir la nacionalidad salvadoreña por nacimiento, cuando teniendo domicilio en El Salvador acrediten un año de residencia definitiva en el país
notes: The onward citizenship step for the Central American limb, and the reason counts_toward_naturalization is true on it. Statutory confirmation of the fee too: art. 325 charges USD 150.00 for 'Otorgamiento de la nacionalidad salvadoreña a los Centroamericanos de origen de conformidad al Art. 90 Ord. 3° de la Constitución' against USD 700.00 for naturalisation.

name: SLV residencia definitiva — Spanish and Hispano-American temporary residents (art. 152(3))
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 152 numeral 3.
quote_original: 3) Residentes temporales de origen español e hispanoamericano que hayan tendido tal condición durante un año de forma ininterrumpida anterior a la solicitud.
notes: One uninterrupted year as a temporary resident instead of three, for temporary residents of Spanish or Hispano-American origin. eligibility_minimum_months 12. The quote preserves the original's typo 'hayan tendido' (for 'tenido') — it is the published text and must not be silently corrected. Onward: art. 156(1) naturalises persons originating in Spain or a Hispano-American country after one year of DEFINITIVE residence, mirroring Constitution art. 92 and the existing el-salvador-naturalization-by-residence route. Recorded as a residence route, not as an ancestry facet: the test is origin in a state, which is the same limb the constitution uses, and it is not being asserted as an origin test in the citizenship layer.

name: SLV residencia definitiva — central-government programmes (art. 152(13))
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 152 numeral 13, added by Decreto Legislativo N.º 286 of 30 April 2025 (Diario Oficial N.º 81, Tomo N.º 447, 5 May 2025) — reform marker (2) in the consolidated text.
quote_original: 13) LOS EXTRANJEROS QUE SE ADHIERAN A LOS PROGRAMAS QUE PROMUEVA EL GOBIERNO CENTRAL, DE LA CLASE QUE FUEREN, SIN NECESIDAD DE OBTENER PREVIAMENTE LA RESIDENCIA TEMPORAL. LA DIRECCIÓN GENERAL DE MIGRACIÓN Y EXTRANJERÍA DEFINIRÁ UN PROCEDIMIENTO ESPECIAL PARA TALES EFECTOS. DICHAS PERSONAS ESTARÁN EXENTAS DE CUMPLIR CON LO REGULADO EN EL ARTÍCULO 154 DE LA PRESENTE LEY. (2)
notes: Foreigners who join programmes promoted by the central government, of whatever class, obtain residencia definitiva WITHOUT prior temporary residence and are expressly exempt from art. 154's absence rules. DGME is to define a special procedure. Authored as a route because the instrument creates it and prices it: the art. 325 fee schedule, amended by the same decree, adds a USD 690.00 line for a first definitive residence 'según el numeral 13) del art. 152' for up to one year — double the ordinary non-Central-American USD 345.00. What is NOT recorded, because it is not published: which programmes qualify, any capital or donation figure, and the special procedure itself. No DGME programme page listing them was found (migracion.gob.sv/programas-migracion/ and /guia-de-programas/ carry no such list). allocation 'discretionary' and no min_investment. Related but separate, and NOT authored here: art. 156(5), added by Decreto Legislativo N.º 918 of 20 December 2023 (marker (1)), lets foreigners meeting the requirements of government programmes aimed at attracting investors or donors naturalise, with DGME to build a 'procedimiento seguro y expedito'. That is a citizenship-layer fact for the existing El Salvador naturalisation block, not a residence row.

name: SLV art. 325 fee schedule — residence tariffs
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 325 (Tasas por servicios migratorios), as amended.
quote_original: Definitiva para no Centroamericanos por primera vez, hasta por un año $345.00 DEFINITIVA PARA PERSONAS EXTRANJERAS SEGÚN EL NUMERAL 13) DEL $690.00 ART. 152, HASTA POR UN AÑO, POR UNA TASA POR (2)
notes: Statutory tariffs, so costs.fees are primary-law figures rather than portal prices. Temporary residence: Central Americans USD 70.00 (one year) / USD 130.00 (two years); non-Central Americans USD 140.00 / USD 260.00. Renewals: USD 55.00 / 100.00 and USD 125.00 / 240.00. Definitive, first grant up to one year: USD 135.00 Central American, USD 345.00 non-Central American, USD 690.00 under art. 152(13). Refrenda of definitive residence: Central Americans USD 30/50/75/95 for one to four years, non-Central Americans USD 65/120/160/205. The quote spans two tariff lines because pdftotext interleaves the amount into the middle of the wrapped art. 152(13) label, which is the document's own layout.

name: SLV naturalisation counts temporary AND definitive residence (art. 156(2))
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 156 numeral 2 (as amended by Decreto Legislativo N.º 918 of 20 December 2023).
quote_original: 2) LOS EXTRANJEROS DE CUALQUIER ORIGEN QUE TUVIEREN CINCO AÑOS DE RESIDENCIA EN EL PAÍS, CONTANDO LAS RESIDENCIAS TEMPORALES Y DEFINITIVAS.
notes: Decisive for counts_toward_naturalization on the temporary rows: the five-year clock counts temporary AND definitive residence, so time under a temporary permit is not wasted. Every El Salvador row authored here therefore carries counts_toward_naturalization true. Art. 159(8) separately requires the definitive-residence card among the naturalisation documents, so the ladder still has to be climbed — the five years are counted from temporary residence, but the application is made as a definitive resident.

name: SLV student residence — no route to residencia definitiva (art. 125)
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 125 (final paragraph).
quote_original: Este tipo de residencia no habilita la obtención de residencia definitiva y deberá salir del país una vez finalizado los objetivos de su estadía, siempre que no solicite cambio de calidad migratoria.
notes: Recorded as a finding, NOT authored as a route. Student temporary residence under art. 109(11) exists and is a real product (DGME form F10), but the residence taxonomy has only investment, digital_nomad, digital_identity, retirement_pension, talent_skilled and general_permanent_residence, and none of them is a study category — filing it under talent_skilled would misstate what it is. The statutory fact worth keeping is the one quoted: this residence does not enable residencia definitiva, though the holder may apply to change category. Also not authored, same reason or no category fit: art. 104 residencia transitoria (seasonal, cross-border and transnational-service workers; art. 104 states transitory residents generate no right of definitive permanence, and art. 107 bars transnational-service workers from applying for definitiva while the employment link with the transnational company subsists); art. 109(18)–(22) protection statuses (refugees, stateless persons, trafficking victims, humanitarian cases) with their arts. 127–143 machinery, which are protection rather than mobility products; art. 109(9) spouse/partner residence, folded into the general temporary residence note.

name: SLV pre-2026 art. 119 predecessor — the 'nine months' figure
instrument: Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería art. 119 as enacted in 2019, before Decreto Legislativo N.º 531 substituted it.
notes: Monitor lead #221 framed the reform as a cut 'from nine months' to ninety days. The new rule is verified; the predecessor is NOT, and no row asserts the delta. What was tried: Decreto 531 substitutes art. 119 outright without reciting the prior text; the Asamblea Legislativa serves only the consolidated law, which already carries the reformed wording; and the 2019 gazette issue (Diario Oficial N.º 75, Tomo N.º 423, 25 April 2019) was not reachable through the diariooficial.gob.sv DataTables portal. One suggestive but non-authoritative trace was found and is recorded here rather than authored: the DGME 'Extranjería' FAQ still answers '¿Puedo salir del país siendo residente?' with 'Los residentes temporales, podrán salir y entrar al país, pero perderán su condición migratoria si su período de ausencia excede de tres meses consecutivos o cuatro meses acumulados en un mismo año.' An absence ceiling of three consecutive or four accumulated months implies a presence floor of roughly eight to nine months, which is very likely where the lead's 'nine months' came from. But it is guidance, it is undated on that page, and it is now stale as against art. 119 — so it is a note, not a source, and certainly not a route. Per the atlas's no-negatives rule the absence of a recorded predecessor is simply silence.

name: SLV Reglamento de la Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería
instrument: Reglamento de la Ley Especial de Migración y de Extranjería (the implementing regulation the Law repeatedly defers to for requirements and procedure).
notes: Arts. 104, 109, 110(5), 111(3), 113, 115, 117, 125, 135 and 138 all defer requirements, forms and procedure to the Reglamento. It was not located on asamblea.gob.sv (the leyes-y-decretos search for the Ley Especial returns exactly three items: D.L. 286 of 2019 and the two reforms) nor linked from migracion.gob.sv, so no requirement that lives only in the Reglamento is asserted in any authored row. This is the main known gap in the El Salvador residence layer: document lists, processing times and per-category detail. processing_typical_months is null on every row for the same reason — the Law states no service standard for residence decisions.
